description: The 2002 SOURCE-clause forms (§2023:13.18.53.2) — more than one operand (the SR6 multi-operand form, whose operands §2023:13.18.53.4 GR4 assigns to successive repetitions of the repeating entry, wrapping to the first when none remain) and the SOURCES/ARE spellings (SR1 — SOURCE and SOURCES are synonyms; SOURCES is 8.9-reserved 'added 2002'). LIVE (kb/Work PB506): the operand list rides ReportFieldModel.Sources, the SR6 count rule is screened by the ONE reader the VALUE clause's twin SR35 uses, and each repetition composes its own operand. The COBOL-85 form was the single 'SOURCE IS identifier-1'.
display: multiple SOURCE operands / SOURCES (report group description)
vcr: 2002 RW addition (SOURCES reserved 'added 2002' in reserved-words.json; the 85 SOURCE format is single-operand, like the LINE and COLUMN clauses it repeats with)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRMS1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT RPT ASSIGN TO "vmrms1.rpt".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD RPT REPORT IS R-1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-A PIC 99 VALUE 7.
01 W-B PIC 99 VALUE 8.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R-1.
01 D-1 TYPE DE.
   03 LINE PLUS 1.
      05 COLUMN 1 12 PIC 99 SOURCES ARE W-A W-B.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT RPT.
    INITIATE R-1.
    GENERATE D-1.
    TERMINATE R-1.
    CLOSE RPT.
    STOP RUN.
